title: page_highlights
description: T-055 C1/C2. A tenant-owned highlight that cites a real page of a document source. Accepted only after validateHighlight against the document's page index; documentHash is that index digest, so a changed document never inherits an old highlight.

_id.description: sha256 over [tenantId, sourceId, documentHash, page, charStart, charEnd, quote]; stable natural identifier so repeat ingestion is idempotent.

page.description: Real page number from the page-aware reader, never derived from offsets.

charStart.description: Document character offset of the quote; kept separate from page.
